capabilities.description: Compose Application-owned local State without confusing it with external domain data.
Handle asynchronous startup, invalidation, teardown, and cleanup deterministically.
Add and manage Behavior concerns with explicit host scope and teardown.
Implement CollectionView child work through public collection and child-view contracts.
Use explicit communication boundaries between independently owned objects.
Reject or repair invalid framework usage through documented public contracts.
Compose nested Applications with explicit lifecycle and ownership.
Compose nested Regions without bypassing Region-owned rendering and teardown.
Implement a stateless View without unnecessary application or state machinery.
Own and release resources, listeners, subscriptions, and disposable work.
Choose correctly among a plain class, optional MnObject, and Application.
Display Views through a shared host Region while keeping positioning and exclusivity outside core.
Keep owner-local State distinct from external model, collection, or domain data.
Compose View-owned local State while preserving View lifecycle boundaries.
